project.title: Electrical biostimulation of AFFF-exposed environmental bacterial communities using microbial electrolysis cells
project.description: This BioProject contains 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data from environmental bacterial communities exposed to a modern fluorotelomer-based aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) and subjected to electrical biostimulation using microbial electrolysis cells (MECs). Microcosms established from six environmentally distinct South Australian water sources were maintained with a continuous 0.7 V applied potential and sampled after 3 and 9 months. These data were generated to assess the influence of electrical biostimulation on bacterial community composition following AFFF exposure. Corresponding pre-treatment and no-voltage control sequence data are available under BioProject accession PRJNA1497669.
